description:
Search companies by ticker, CIK, or name

Search deterministic company identity records by ticker, CIK, or company name. Deterministic ordering is ticker ASC, active_from ASC, active_to ASC NULLS LAST, cik ASC with a fixed tie-break. Responses use the canonical PaginatedEnvelope.

query.description: Ticker, CIK or part of a company name to match.

name: identity_search
